item.title: Elon Musk takes stand in Twitter shareholder trial accusing him of deflating stock before purchase
item.description: Elon Musk took the stand in a shareholder trial on Wednesday in San Francisco, where he’s accused of making false and misleading statements that drove down Twitter’s stock price before he bought the social media platform for $44 billion in 2022.
